nodes.title: Maren
nodes.synopsis: The village baker of Hollowbrook. Steady hands, unsteady patience; her small magic lives in proofing dough and reading weather in flour dust.

nodes.title: Edda
nodes.synopsis: Maren's rival — keeps the mill and contests every festival bake. The rivalry is old, ritualized, and neither would survive its ending.

nodes.title: Tam
nodes.synopsis: Maren's apprentice, too curious about the Edge by half. The only villager who has asked the forest a question out loud.

sources.span: Apprentice: Tam. She took him on after the flood year and does not explain why.

nodes.title: Old Wick
nodes.synopsis: Lamplighter and keeper of the crossing-stones. Speaks of the Rules of Small Magic as if quoting someone no one else remembers.

nodes.title: Sela
nodes.synopsis: A traveling mender who appears in Story 2 only. Whether she returns — or was ever ordinary — is deliberately unsettled.

nodes.title: Hollowbrook
nodes.synopsis: The village itself: a brook that runs quieter than it should, houses that lean toward each other, and a habit of not asking why.

nodes.title: The Edge
nodes.synopsis: The forest at the village bound. Deep, non-personal, older than the village's memory of itself. It is not hostile; it is indifferent, which is worse.

nodes.title: The Bakery
nodes.synopsis: Maren's domain and the village's warm center. Half the stories start here because bread is where news travels.

sources.span: Keeps the bakery at the village center.

nodes.title: The Millpond
nodes.synopsis: Edda's mill and its still water. Things reflected in the millpond are occasionally a day ahead.

nodes.title: Rules of Small Magic
nodes.synopsis: The cosmology: magic is small, domestic, and paid for in kind. True on every page, never explained on any page.

nodes.title: Why the brook runs quiet
nodes.synopsis: Open thread: the brook's silence is noticed in two stories but unexplained. Candidate link to the Rules; unratified.

sources.span: If the brook is quiet because something is listening, that's a thread.
Its quiet is remarked on by villagers and never explained

nodes.title: The Wild Clearing
nodes.synopsis: Story 3 mentions a clearing deep in the Edge where small magic runs large. Proposed new place — connect to the Edge? New node?

sources.span: a clearing deep in the Edge where small magic runs large

nodes.title: The Ferryman
nodes.synopsis: Referenced once in Story 3 dialogue ('the ferryman knows the other bank'). No ferry exists in Hollowbrook. Proposed cast node; unratified.

sources.span: the ferryman knows the other bank
I want him on the board but I'm not ready to make him real.

nodes.title: Bread as payment
nodes.synopsis: Pattern noticed across stories: small magic is settled in baked goods. Candidate rule-of-thumb under the Rules; unratified.

sources.span: small magic is settled in baked goods
